title: C: Temperature Converter
description: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using the formula F = C * 9/5 + 32.

steps.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
steps.description: Declare `double celsius = 25.0`. Compute fahrenheit using the formula and print '25.0C = 77.0F'.
hints: Use `%.1f` to format to one decimal place.

verification.failureMessage: Convert 25.0C to Fahrenheit and print the result
